verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS AI assistant like Lindy, but the pack documents no export feature, no open-format download, and no account-exit or offboarding path. The Files page only lets users browse Lindy's own files, and GDPR compliance is a compliance claim, not a documented export capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
